dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration (likely associated with an occult malignancy such as small cell lung, breast, or ovarian carcinoma, or Hodgkin lymphoma)

Alternatives:
1. Drug-induced cerebellar toxicity (e.g., chronic phenytoin or carbamazepine use)
2. Alcohol-related cerebellar degeneration
3. Spinocerebellar ataxia (genetic late-onset cerebellar degeneration)
